messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. I want to make something crafted and polished — a real illustration, not a clip-art stub. Let me think about composition: a pelican standing tall on a bicycle, big beak with pouch, wings on handlebars, spinning wheels, motion lines, maybe a background.

Let me design a nice SVG with:
- ViewBox around 800x600
- A sky gradient background, sun, some clouds, ground, motion lines
- A bicycle with two wheels (spokes), frame, seat, handlebars, pedals, chain
- A pelican sitting on the seat, body, wing gripping handlebar, legs on pedals, large yellow-orange beak with pouch, eye, small head tuft, scarf maybe
- Motion lines behind, blurred cactus, road.
- CSS animations in the SVG: wheels spinning, scarf fluttering, motion lines pulsing, slight bobbing of pelican.

Animations: use <style> inside SVG with @keyframes. transform-origin must be set properly. For wheels, use transform-origin at wheel center — SVG transform-origin can be given as pixels which map to user units in most browsers. Safer: wrap wheel group in <g> with transform translate(cx,cy) so rotation origin at 0,0, animate rotate on inner group. That's clean.

Let me build.

Actually I could animate cranks + feet together via a group containing pedal and foot... complex. Better: static cranks, spinning wheels + motion streaks + fluttering scarf + bobbing whole bike+pelican (translateY). Bobbing the whole group is nice: a "ride" bounce.

Hmm, if wheels spin and bike bobs, fine.

- chain: stroke-dashoffset animation.
- whole rig bob: translateY 0 → -4 → 0, 0.6s ease-in-out infinite (careful: bob the group containing bike+pelican).
- scarf: rotate/scale flutter using transform on scarf group with origin at neck (use transform-box: fill-box? Simpler: animate d via CSS path morph not supported well. Use a rotate on scarf tail group anchored via translate trick: <g transform="translate(310,190)"><g class="scarf">...</g></g>)
- motion streaks: opacity + translateX animation.
- sun rays rotate slowly.
- eye blink? Could animate rect scaleY — skip or do simple blink via animating eyelid opacity.
- clouds drifting.

Also hover interactions? The request is static SVG; hover micro-interactions nice: on hover the pelican tips? Maybe hover on the bike group speeds up wheels — do with CSS `svg:hover .wheel { animation-duration: .35s }`. Good touch. Also hover on pelican makes scarf flutter more.

Let me be careful that CSS animation with SMIL fallback isn't necessary. Use CSS keyframes — works in browsers. Provide prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable animations. Nice craft.

So wheel content drawn around origin (0,0) and use positions it. But the spinning spokes group inside — CSS animation applies to shadow tree elements of use? Animation on class inside a referenced element works (styles apply to the shadow content in browsers generally). Safer to duplicate wheel markup twice explicitly. That's fine.
